text: Lionel Messi led Argentina to victory in the FIFA World Cup final against France on December 18, 2022 in Lusail, Qatar.
The International Olympic Committee selected Brisbane, Australia to host the 2032 Summer Olympics on July 21, 2021.
FIFA banned Russia from all international football competitions on February 28, 2022 in Zurich.
Usain Bolt's 100m world record was broken by Noah Lyles at the World Athletics Championships on August 20, 2023 in Budapest.
Manchester City won the UEFA Champions League defeating Inter Milan 1-0 on June 10, 2023 in Istanbul.
Novak Djokovic won his 24th Grand Slam title at the US Open on September 10, 2023 in New York.
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund acquired Newcastle United Football Club on October 7, 2021 in London.
The World Anti-Doping Agency investigated Chinese swimmers for positive drug tests before the Tokyo Olympics on April 20, 2024.
Real Madrid signed Kylian Mbappe from Paris Saint-Germain on June 3, 2024 in Madrid.
India hosted and won the Cricket World Cup semi-final against New Zealand on November 15, 2023 in Mumbai.
NASA's James Webb Space Telescope captured its first deep field image on July 12, 2022 from Goddard Space Flight Center.
CERN scientists announced the discovery of a new type of pentaquark on July 5, 2022 in Geneva.
China completed construction of its Tiangong space station on November 3, 2022.
South Korea launched its first domestically built space rocket Nuri on June 21, 2022 from Naro Space Center.
DeepMind's AlphaFold predicted the structure of nearly every known protein, published on July 28, 2022 in London.
Japan's SLIM spacecraft achieved a precision landing on the Moon on January 19, 2024.
The European Space Agency launched the JUICE mission to Jupiter on April 14, 2023 from French Guiana.
Scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory achieved nuclear fusion ignition on December 5, 2022 in California.
Russia withdrew from the International Space Station partnership agreement on July 26, 2022.
Neuralink implanted its first brain chip in a human patient on January 29, 2024 in Austin, Texas.
The WHO declared mpox a global health emergency on July 23, 2022 in Geneva.
Pfizer and BioNTech developed an updated COVID-19 vaccine targeting the Omicron variant released on September 1, 2022.
China lifted its zero-COVID policy after widespread protests on December 7, 2022 in Beijing.
The European Medicines Agency approved Novavax's COVID-19 vaccine on December 20, 2021 in Amsterdam.
Uganda declared an Ebola outbreak in the Mubende district on September 20, 2022.
Johnson & Johnson agreed to pay $8.9 billion to settle talcum powder cancer lawsuits on April 4, 2023.
India provided 100 million COVID-19 vaccine doses to African nations through the COVAX program on March 15, 2022.
The FDA approved the first CRISPR-based gene therapy treatment on December 8, 2023 in Washington.
North Korea reported its first COVID-19 outbreak on May 12, 2022 in Pyongyang.
Brazil's health ministry declared a dengue fever emergency affecting 1,000 cities on February 6, 2024.
South Korea's Squid Game became the most-watched Netflix series globally on October 12, 2021.
The British Museum suffered a major theft of 2,000 artifacts reported on August 16, 2023 in London.
UNESCO added Kyiv's historic center to its list of World Heritage Sites in Danger on January 25, 2023.
Japan's Studio Ghibli won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature with The Boy and the Heron on March 10, 2024 in Los Angeles.
France returned 26 looted colonial artifacts to Benin on November 9, 2021 in Paris.
Taylor Swift's Eras Tour became the highest-grossing concert tour in history surpassing $1 billion on December 8, 2023.
China banned effeminate men from appearing on television on September 2, 2021 in Beijing.
The Louvre Museum in Paris reached a record 10 million visitors in 2023 announced on January 19, 2024.
Nigeria's Afrobeats artist Burna Boy performed at a sold-out concert at London Stadium on June 24, 2023.
Saudi Arabia announced plans to build a museum designed by architect Jean Nouvel in Riyadh on December 15, 2022.
Interpol arrested the world's most wanted drug trafficker in Colombia on October 22, 2022.
The FBI raided former President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate on August 8, 2022 in Florida.
A New York jury found Donald Trump guilty on 34 felony counts on May 30, 2024.
Mexico extradited drug lord Rafael Caro Quintero to the United States on July 15, 2022.
Australian police dismantled a major cybercrime syndicate operating across Southeast Asia on March 14, 2023.
The International Criminal Court convicted a Ugandan rebel commander for war crimes on February 4, 2021 in The Hague.
Japan executed the former leader of the Aum Shinrikyo cult responsible for the Tokyo subway attack on July 6, 2018.
El Salvador's President Bukele arrested over 60,000 gang members during a state of emergency declared on March 27, 2022.
France convicted former President Nicolas Sarkozy of corruption on March 1, 2021 in Paris.
Europol shut down the world's largest dark web marketplace on April 5, 2022 in The Hague.
